shows.title: Evita
shows.description: *Evita* is the riveting story of the rise and fall of the glamorous First Lady of Argentina.

shows.title: Mermaids & Pirates
shows.description:
Mermaids & Pirates features a shipload of unforgettable characters, including the Seasick Pirate, a crazy castaway and Isla, Queen of the Island.
Packed with calypso-infused songs, salsa-styled choreography and plenty of comic surprises, this one-hour musical celebrates teamwork, courage and the magic of the Caribbean.
